title: HHS Filing Puts iRhythm Data Breach Toll at 8.2 Million
description: In June 2026, iRhythm, a medical equipment provider specializing in wearable cardiac monitors, suffered a data breach impacting over 8.1 million individuals. Hackers accessed personal information and iRhythm account and device data from third-party-hosted business applications and attempted to extort a ransom. The compromised data includes names, addresses, dates of birth, email addresses, phone numbers, and device-related identifiers. iRhythm has not found evidence of identity theft or impact on its medical devices or operations. Notifications have been sent to affected individuals and regulatory bodies, including the US Department of Health and Human Services.
